title: Kalanagar-BKC Multi-Tier Grade Separator & Elevated Connector
junctionName: Western Express Highway & BKC Connector Junction
problemDescription: Severe weaving conflict between Sea Link northbound exit traffic and BKC commercial ingress, producing 28 mins daily queueing back to Santacruz.
existingInfrastructure: 6-lane surface arterial with complex 5-phase signalized rotary.
trafficObservations: Peak hour volume: 8,400 PCU/hr against 4,800 PCU/hr design capacity (V/C ratio: 1.75).
expectedBenefits: Eliminates 65% of surface cross-traffic waiting; throughput increases by +52%; saves 22 mins per commuter trip.
engineeringConsiderations: Utility diversion of 1800mm Vaitarna water transmission main and coordination with elevated Metro Line 2B pier portals.
